turns.reply:
I fixed the traceback recursion in `rich/traceback.py` by making the exception-chain walk skip any exception it has already visited, so a cause or context cycle can no longer loop forever. The patch is submitted (one file, 10 insertions, 2 deletions).

The change adds a `seen_exceptions` set in `Traceback.extract`, records each exception's id as it is processed, and skips a `__cause__` or `__context__` whose id is already in the set. I also added `Set` to the `typing` imports.

I checked it with a self-referencing `__context__` case, which now yields 2 stacks instead of hanging, and `tests/test_traceback.py` passes (21 passed, 1 skipped). I did not add a test for the cycle case, and the issue text was only a title, so the fix is based on my reading of the two linked issues rather than their stated reproducers.
